reasoning: As of March 2026, the question asks if 19+ of 27 EU member states will recognize Palestinian statehood by July 2026. The background indicates France was set to recognize in September 2025, bringing the count to 12. This requires 7 more recognitions in ~4 months. While some EU states have shown openness to recognition, the pace needed is rapid. US opposition under Trump (threatening trade consequences) creates diplomatic pressure against recognition. However, some EU states may act independently on principle. The timeframe is very tight for such a significant policy shift across multiple countries.
